targets.expr: 8 * sum by (namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod, interface) ((rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""}[5m]) and (container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""} and (time() - timestamp(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""}) < 180))) and on(job, instance, metrics_path) ((up{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"}) < 180)) == 1))) and on(namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",phase="Running"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",phase="Running"}) < 180)) == 1)) and on() (max((up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"}) < 180))) == 1)) and on(namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",host_network="false"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",host_network="false"}) < 180)) == 1))

8 * sum by (namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod, interface) ((rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""}[5m]) and (container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""} and (time() - timestamp(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",container="POD",interface!="lo",interface!=""}) < 180))) and on(job, instance, metrics_path) ((up{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"}) < 180)) == 1))) and on(namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",phase="Running"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",phase="Running"}) < 180)) == 1)) and on() (max((up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"}) < 180))) == 1)) and on(namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",host_network="false"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main",namespace="cleanuparr",pod=~"cleanuparr-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",host_network="false"}) < 180)) == 1))
